method: Compare production nominal_flap_geometry centers/root orientation against actual flap link poses plus composed static box_geometry center.
limitations: These measurements cover startup neutral holding only; no hand-contact grasp phase is measured.
Static asset geometry is read after the runs; the measured local centers are zero for the used small/medium panels.
This audit does not quantify actual jaw-close gate mismatch or prove a cause of poor learning.
finding: Neutral holding in valid layouts leaves only small nominal flap error. Large startup deviations concentrate in invalid layouts; grasp-time panel motion still needs measurement.
